description: Source code implementing MD5 and SHA256 hashing functions, including command-line utility for hashing files with options for MD5 and SHA256, and handling multiple files.

methods.name: be32enc
methods.description: Encodes a 32-bit unsigned integer into a buffer in big-endian format.

methods.name: be64enc
methods.description: Encodes a 64-bit unsigned integer into a buffer in big-endian format.

methods.name: be16dec
methods.description: Decodes a 16-bit unsigned integer from a buffer in big-endian format.

methods.name: be32dec
methods.description: Decodes a 32-bit unsigned integer from a buffer in big-endian format.

methods.name: MD5_end
methods.description: Finalizes MD5 hash and outputs result.

methods.name: SHA256_Final
methods.description: Finalizes SHA256 hash and outputs result.

methods.name: hash_buf
methods.description: Reads data from file into buffer.

methods.name: hash_string
methods.description: Converts hash buffer to hex string.

methods.name: md5_hash
methods.description: Computes MD5 hash of a file.

methods.name: sha256_hash
methods.description: Computes SHA256 hash of a file.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the command-line utility.

methods.name: get_hash_type
methods.description: Retrieves hash type struct based on name.

methods.name: hash_file
methods.description: Hashes a file with specified hash type and optionally adds filename to output.
